name: Sample Gizmo Motor
fullName: Sample Gizmo Motor 0.0L imaginary twin (practice fixture)
summary: A made-up unit used to build and test the app before the real rebuild content lands. Every part name here is invented. Do not use any of it on a real engine.
notes: This is a practice fixture with obviously fake names. It exists so every game mode can be tested without real data.
Special tools: the Wobble Shaft Holder (fake) and a Sprocket Persuader (also fake).

phases.name: Prep
phases.summary: Get the pretend unit on the bench and drained.

phases.name: Teardown
phases.summary: Take the gizmo apart in order.

phases.name: Inspect and measure
phases.summary: Check the invented parts for wear.

phases.name: Reassembly
phases.summary: Put it back together in reverse.

steps.title: Photograph the gizmo harness
steps.action: Take photos of every connector and clip before anything comes off.
steps.why: Photos are your reassembly map later.

steps.title: Drain the sump tray
steps.action: Pull the drain plug and let the pretend oil empty into a pan.
steps.why: Oil left in the sump spills everywhere once the unit is tipped.

steps.title: Mount on the wobble stand
steps.action: Bolt the unit to the stand at its four fake mounting points.
steps.why: A secured unit can be rotated safely for teardown.
steps.mistake: Using only two bolts and letting the unit tip.

steps.title: Bag and label fasteners
steps.action: Set out labeled bags for each area so bolts never mix.

steps.title: Remove the gizmo cover
steps.action: Unbolt the cover in a criss-cross pattern and lift it off.
steps.why: The cover hides the rubber band and must come off first.

steps.title: Set number one to top
steps.action: Rotate the doohickey crank until the timing marks line up.
steps.why: Locking timing at a known position makes reassembly repeatable.
steps.mistake: Rotating backwards past the mark and misreading it.

steps.title: Lock the wobble shaft
steps.action: Fit the Wobble Shaft Holder so the shaft cannot spin.
steps.why: The shaft is spring-loaded and will snap out of time when the band is released.

steps.title: Release the band tensioner
steps.action: Back the tensioner off slowly and pin it.

steps.title: Remove the timing rubber band
steps.action: Slide the band off both sprockets and bin it.
steps.why: A used band is never reused.

steps.title: Pull the sprocket
steps.action: Use the Sprocket Persuader to draw the sprocket off its taper.

steps.title: Lift out the wobble shaft
steps.action: Remove the holder and lift the shaft straight up.

steps.title: Remove the sump tray
steps.action: Unbolt the tray and break the sealant with a plastic scraper.
steps.mistake: Prying with a screwdriver and gouging the flange.

steps.title: Push out the flux pistons
steps.action: Unbolt each rod cap and push the pistons out the top.
steps.why: The sump must be off first to reach the rod caps.

steps.title: Remove the doohickey crank
steps.action: Unbolt the main caps in reverse of the tightening sequence and lift the crank out.

steps.title: Measure flux piston clearance
steps.action: Measure the bore and piston and compare the difference to the spec.

steps.title: Check crank journal wear
steps.action: Mic each journal at two points ninety degrees apart.

steps.title: Inspect the wobble shaft lobes
steps.action: Look for pitting and measure lobe height.

steps.title: Clean every mating surface
steps.action: Scrape old sealant and wipe surfaces with solvent.
steps.why: New sealant will not bond to old sealant.

steps.title: Install the doohickey crank
steps.action: Lube the journals, set the crank in, and torque the main caps in sequence.
steps.mistake: Torquing caps out of sequence and binding the crank.

steps.title: Fit the flux pistons
steps.action: Compress the rings and tap each piston in with the arrow toward the front.

steps.title: Seal and fit the sump tray
steps.action: Run a bead of sealant and install the tray within the working time.

steps.title: Install and lock the wobble shaft
steps.action: Set the shaft in and fit the holder again.

steps.title: Press on the sprocket
steps.action: Seat the sprocket on its taper and torque the center bolt.

steps.title: Fit a new rubber band
steps.action: Route the band, release the tensioner, then remove the shaft holder.
steps.why: The holder comes out only after the band is under tension.
steps.mistake: Pulling the holder before tensioning and losing timing.

steps.title: Rotate twice and recheck marks
steps.action: Turn the crank two full turns by hand and confirm the marks line up.
steps.why: Proves timing before any covers hide it.
